example: The man who lived an abandoned life was despised by his family.
祕段落: 字根 band 表示『禁止』；a- 有『不』之意，合起來可聯想為不受禁止、恣意放蕩，並引申為被放棄的。

example: The teacher highly recommended the books of abbreviated version to his students.
祕段落: 字首 ab- 有『離去』之意，字根 brev 表『短』，-iate 為動詞字尾，合起來就是使內容變短。

example: All abbreviations used in this essay are to be explained.
祕段落: 由 abbreviate 去掉字尾 e 加上 -ion 形成名詞，表示縮寫或縮寫字。

example: If you want to play the game, you must abide by the rules.
祕段落: 字首 a- 可表『加強』，字根 bide 表『居住、停留』，引申為容忍、遵守。

example: According to the latest survey, most people think the death penalty should not be abolished.
祕段落: 字首 ab- 表『相反』，-olish 可聯想到 polish（使光滑、磨掉），合起來引申為徹底廢除。

example: She came to this state to go through voluntary abortion, which is legal here.
祕段落: 字首 ab- 表『相反、離去』，字根 ort 表『升起、開始』，-ion 為名詞字尾，聯想為生命不再開始而中止。

example: The absent-minded professor lost his wallet again.
祕段落: absent 表『不在場的』，minded 表『有某種心思的』，合起來表示心思不在當下。

example: He noticed there was an air of abstraction on her face.
祕段落: 字首 abs- 表『離開』，字根 tract 表『拉、抽取』，-ion 為名詞字尾，合起來為抽離、提取，並引申為抽象。

example: You can disagree with her suggestion but it was impolite of you to say it was absurd.
中文: 荒唐的；不合理的；可笑的
祕段落: 字首 ab- 表『離開』，surd 表『聾的』，可聯想為離開正常人的理智，荒唐得像聽不進話。

example: Thanks to the fine weather, there was an abundance of rice last year.
祕段落: 由動詞 abound（充滿）去掉字尾再加 -ance 形成名詞，表示豐富、充足。

example: The country is abundant in crude iron but still has to import some from other countries.
祕段落: 字根 und 表『波浪』，-ant 為形容詞字尾；一波接一波，像豐富到滿溢。

example: Time was running out; therefore he accelerated the car.
祕段落: 字首 ac- 表『加強』，字根 celer 表『速度』，-ate 為動詞字尾，合起來就是加快速度。

example: Please keep the medicine in a place which is not accessible to children.
中文: 可接近的；可進入的；可使用的
祕段落: access 表『進入、接近』，-ible 表『可以……的』，因此為可進入、可接近或可使用的。

example: They acclaimed him king but he refused.
祕段落: 字首 ac- 表『對著』，claim 表『呼喊』；對著某人歡呼，因而有喝采、擁立之意。

example: If you don't play the game in accordance with the rules, we will foul you out.
祕段落: 字首 ac- 表『到』，字根 cord 表『心』，彼此的心到達同一理念，因此表示一致。

example: She was too weak to continue. Accordingly, we sent her home.
祕段落: 字首 ac- 表『對著』，cord 表『心』，accord 有一致、同意之意，加 -ingly 成副詞，表示照著、因此。

example: Snow accumulated to a depth of 8 feet and it was impossible to drive out.
祕段落: 字首 ac- 表『加強』，字根 cumulate 表『聚集』，合起來就是不斷累積、積聚。

example: There is an accumulation of work waiting to be done, so I can't watch TV.
祕段落: 由 accumulate 去掉 e 加上 -ion 形成名詞，表示積累或積聚物。

example: She quickly accustomed herself to the new life in this city and made several friends.
祕段落: 字首 ac- 表『在、到』，costume 可聯想到每天穿同樣服裝，日久成習慣。

example: We acknowledge that he is a genius, but even a genius can also make mistakes.
祕段落: 字首 ac- 表『在、到』，knowledge 是知識；讓大家都『知道』，即承認、認知。

example: Next to acquiring good books, the best acquisition is that of good films.
祕段落: 由 acquire 去掉 re 後加 -sition 形成名詞，可聯想為獲得、取得之物。

example: Our president is absent; therefore the acting president will talk with you.
中文: 代理的；臨時的；演出用的
祕段落: act 為『做、演』，加 -ing 成形容詞；表示暫代職務或用於演出。

example: All these activists must be included in the project.
中文: 行動主義者；激進主義分子
祕段落: act 表『動作、行動』，-ist 表『人』，合起來就是採取行動的人。

example: Her judgment is acute, so we'd better trust her.
祕段落: 字首 a- 表『加強』，字根 cute 可聯想到精明伶俐，因而引申為敏銳、尖銳。

example: As an adaptation, this play is better than the original novel.
祕段落: 字首 ad- 表『一再』，字根 apt 表『適當的』；一再調整到適當狀態，便是適應或改編。

example: These film addicts go to the movies every Sunday no matter what the weather is like.
祕段落: 字首 ad- 表『向、對』，字根 dict 表『說、表示』；像被某物反覆召喚，形成過度喜愛或成癮。

example: The man who was addicted to cigarettes finally gave up smoking for his children's sake.
祕段落: 由 addict 加 -ed 形成形容詞，表示已經成癮、入迷。

example: Researchers found an addiction to drugs could lead one towards a life of crime.
祕段落: 由 addict 加 -ion 形成名詞，表示沈溺、上癮或入迷。

example: You cannot marry one who uses addictive drugs.
祕段落: 由 addict 加 -ive 形成形容詞，表示會使人成癮的。

example: The company adheres to the principle that those who work more will get more.
祕段落: 字首 ad- 表『在』，字根 her 表『黏貼、附著』，因此有黏附並引申為堅持、遵守。

example: He doesn't know that New Jersey adjoins New York.
祕段落: 字首 ad- 表『在』，join 表『連接、結合』，合起來就是連接在一起、毗鄰。

example: He made a few minor adjustments to the seating plan without the permission of the host.
祕段落: 字首 ad- 表『使』，字根 just 表『正確』，合起來就是使其正確，因而有調整之意。

example: It not only takes time but also brains to administer a large company.
祕段落: 字首 ad- 可表『去』，minister 原指部長、大臣；擔任管理者，需要處理與執行事務。

example: His administrative ability was not recognized until he solved the problem.
祕段落: 由 administer 去掉 er 加 -rative 形成形容詞，表示管理或行政方面的。

example: The man who was said to be a born administrator won the election.
中文: 管理人；有行政或管理才能的人
祕段落: 由 administer 去掉 er 加 -rator，-or 表『人』，因此是管理者或行政人員。

example: Should they be forgiven because the mistakes were made in their adolescence?
祕段落: 可聯想 adolescent（青少年）加名詞字尾 -ence，表示青春期或青少年時期。
